This matter is taken up through Hybrid mode.

2. Heard learned counsel for the Parties and perused the records.
3.

The Petitioner apprehending his arrest in Khantapada P.S. Case No.136 of 2024, corresponding to Special Case No.185 of 2024, pending in the Court of learned ADJ-cum-POCSO Court, Balasore,
registered for alleged commission of offences punishable under Sections 363, 376(3), 376(2)(n), 506 of IPC read with Sections 4 & 6 of the POCSO Act, has filed this petitioner for his release on pre-arrest bail.
4. It is stated by learned counsel for the Petitioner that one of the co-accused persons stand in a similar footing has already been released on bail in the meantime.

5. Considering the submissions made by the parties, it is observed that the Petitioner, if so advised,
may surrender before the learned ADJ-cum-POCSO Court, Balasore, in the aforesaid case within four weeks from today.

In the event the Petitioner surrenders and moves for bail within the aforesaid period, learned ADJ-cum- POCSO Court, Balasore, shall do well to dispose of the bail application of the Petitioner on the same day on merit in accordance with law.
The case diary be made available to the concerned court to facilitate disposal of the bail application of the Petitioner.
